div.head: II As 20.4
div.ab: ⁊ se þe be witum geswican nylle, ðonne ridon þa yldestan men to, ealle þe to þære byrig hyron, ⁊ nimon eall ðæt he age — ⁊ fó se cyng to healfum, to healfum ða men ðe on þære rade beon — ⁊ setton hine on borh.

⁊ se þe be ðissum geswican nylle, ðonne riden ða yldestan men, ealle þe to ðære byrig hyren, ⁊ nimen ealle þæt he age—⁊ fó se cyng to healfum, to healfum ða men þe on þære rád syn—⁊ setten hine on borh.

⁊ se þe be þysum geswican nelle, donne riden . . . ieldestan men ealle to, þe to þære byrg hyren, ⁊ nim:: eall þæt he age — ⁊ fo se cing to healfum, to healfum þa m:: :: on þære rade sien — ⁊ setten hine on borh.

Et qui propter hoc (se) abstinere noluerit, eant omnes maiores natu qui adiacent ipsi curie, et capiant quicquid habet; et manus iniciat rex ad dimidium, ipsi homines ad dimidium qui in ipso itinere sunt; et ponant eum sub fideiussoribus.

⁊ se þe be [ðissum] geswican nylle, ðonne ridon þa yldestan men to, ealle þe to þære byrig hyron, ⁊ nimon eall ðæt he age—⁊ fó se cyng to healfum, to healfum ða men ðe on þære rade beon—⁊ setton hine on borh.

Und wer wegen dessen (der Strafen H) nicht [vom Verbrechen] abstehen will: da sollen alle die angesehensten Leute, die zu dieser Gerichtsstadt gehören, [zu ihm] hinziehen und alles, was er hat, fortnehmen — und [davon] die Hälfte ergreife der König, die Hälfte [erhalten] die Leute, welche bei diesem Zuge sind — und ihn unter Bürgschaft stellen.

And whoever will not desist [from crime] on account of this (of the penalties, H): then all the most senior men who belong to that court-town are to ride [to him] and take everything that he has — and let the king seize half [of it], [and] the men who are on that riding half — and put him under surety.

Again, if any even then will not desist, all the chief men who belong to the borough shall ride and take all he possesses, and the king shall receive half, and the men who ride to apprehend him the other half, and they shall place him under surety.

And he who will not cease for these penalties—the leading men are to ride thither, all who belong to the borough, and take all that he owns. The king is to succeed to half, to half the men who are on that expedition. And they are to put him under surety.

Wiederholung von 20, 1; vgl. Gl Gesetz 9 c; Zehnerschaft 10 b; c. — Ich glaube nicht, dass nur das Vorgehen hier als gleich geschildert werde gegenüber verschiedenen Fällen, nämlich dem Rechtsweigerer in 20, 1 und dem Gewohnheitsverbrecher hier, der später ‘oft bezichtigt’ (III Eg 7) heisst; vgl. Gl Rückfall

Repetition of 20, 1; cf. Gl Gesetz 9 c; Zehnerschaft 10 b; c. — I do not believe that only the procedure is described here as being the same for different cases, namely the man who refuses justice in 20, 1 and the habitual criminal here, who is later called ‘often accused’ (III Eg 7); cf. Gl Rückfall
Dieselbe Halbierung VI 1, 1; dagegen steht statt des Königs seit Eadgar der mit Strafgeld-Empfang privilegierte Herr (u. 21⁵); vgl. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 5 c. f; Polizei 1 C
The same halving in VI 1, 1; but from Eadgar onwards the lord privileged to receive fines (below 21⁵) stands in place of the king; cf. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 5 c. f; Polizei 1 C
